gemini.value: A new Spring Valley quarantine notice took effect on June 16, 2026, newly flagging 3 shipments (SR-1010, SR-1016, and SR-1023). This quarantine covers a generated zone of about 63.6 sq mi (official: 76.0 sq mi) affecting 22.5 acres of avocado commercial agriculture.
